source: AI Image Skill Catalog - creative direction vocabulary
notes: Attribute vocabulary used to build prompts and to rewrite artist-name requests into neutral visual attributes.

50mm prime lens, natural field of view
85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, compressed background
macro lens, extreme close detail, shallow focus

blue hour ambience, cool ambient light, warm practical lights
overcast diffused daylight, soft shadowless light
large softbox key light, soft falloff, clean catchlights
three-point lighting, key fill and rim separation
hard midday sun, crisp short shadows, high contrast
candlelight, warm low key, deep shadows
neon signage lighting, magenta and cyan bounce, wet reflections
cool moonlight, silver highlights, deep blue shadows
high-key lighting, bright airy exposure, minimal shadow

glossy reflective surface with sharp specular highlights

leading lines drawing the eye to the focal point

medium.value: editorial illustration, clean vector-like shapes, flat colour
watercolour painting, soft pigment blooms, visible paper tooth
ink drawing, confident line work, cross-hatching
oil painting, impasto brushwork, rich glazing
technical illustration, precise linework, annotated engineering style
flat vector artwork, geometric shapes, no gradients
physically based 3D render, global illumination, soft studio HDRI
pixel art, limited palette, hard edges, deliberate clusters

composition_notes.text_to_image: state the subject first, then environment, then framing, then light, then palette, then medium, then quality
composition_notes.negative_prompt: name the defect class you are trying to avoid, not the subject you want

artist_style_rewrite.policy: Requests naming a living artist are rewritten into neutral, attribute-level visual descriptions. The rewrite preserves the creative intent without instructing the model to imitate a specific artist's recognisable style.
generic_fallback: describe the medium, the brush or rendering behaviour, the lighting, the palette and the mood instead of the artist name
